case_title: DELGADO, MARIO GUSTAVO VS PADILLA DORATRIZ DBA FURNITURE GALORE

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $7,500.00 FILED BY DELGADO, MARIO GUSTAVO AS TO DEFENDANT PADILLA DORATRIZ DBA FURNITURE GALORE ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAR-21-2006 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506
